summary: Fixed the probe harness's observation identity schema and re-declared the comparisons, then requested a fresh execution of the revised experiment (previous_id = d1f90214ba9e4bddb459fb42ceca092b-experiment). The earlier receipt (3c91f30ab0264ff08ffde51d0b594ace) executed cleanly and its event stream already showed the predicted behaviour (recovery self reply VBallot 8 with Status NONE and no command; quorum reply from replica 2 carrying the PUT at VBallot 0; recovered PreAccept carrying the NOOP; replica 2 and replica 3 ending COMMITTED with the NOOP while the crashed leader holds X), but both comparisons returned unknown because the admission events lacked the identity fields of their result events (recovery_start carried no per-recipient field, prepare_reply carried 'from' rather than 'replica'). The revision makes prepare_reply report the acceptor as replica and emits one consolidated recovery_proposal event per recovery, so admission and result events share identity; the message flow, handlers, ballots and scenario are unchanged. Interpretation of the receipt and closure of the reachability gap remain outstanding.
